messages:
mina: quick sync — we keep seeing noisy failures in the onboarding smoke when we run sparse bench probes against schema v2. the anchoring logic seems to be the culprit, leaking transient tokenization diffs into the acceptance signal.
ajohnson: can you show a concrete case? is this the kv-cache + tokenizer combo or something else?
mina: example: model A passes full-bench but fails sparse-probe 1/10 runs. logs show token offsets shifted by 1 for a subset of inputs. config: ```prober:
  mode: sparse
  anchor_strategy: last-success
  sample_seed: null
  allow_offset_tolerance: false
```
sara: that config is the problem — `last-success` anchor is stateful and brittle for models with tokenizer edgecases. would rather use an anchor that is either deterministic (golden) or distribution-based percentiles.
raul: +1 on determinism but note cost implications. full golden runs are expensive for large-vocab models. we need a middle ground: small deterministic subset + adaptive distribution sampling.
eva: propose metrics to signal this: "anchor_shift_rate", "token_offset_variance", "sparse_fail_burst_count". thresholds: anchor_shift_rate > 0.02 => fail-fast review, token_offset_variance > 3 => route to full bench.
bench-bot: automated note: recent onboarding runs (model-A) triggered sparse_fail_burst_count=4 in last 24h — created ticket #ONB-372.
mina: idea: change `anchor_strategy` options to: `golden_set`, `live-distribution`, `hybrid-sampler`. hybrid = deterministic golden subset + reservoir-sampled distribution checks at lower QPS. meaning: fast failure detection + coverage for long-tail.
ajohnson: hybrid sounds sensible. for reservoir we should fix sampling seed control so runs are reproducible for debug. store sample manifest with model-version.
sara: also add a schema contract: tokenizer fingerprint + vocab-hash in the descriptor. any mismatch increments anchor_shift_rate. simple and cheap to compute.
eva: + also store percentiles: p50/p95 token lengths from onboarding traffic and compare against bench sample distribution. if p95 deviates > 15% -> trigger deeper validation.
raul: on implementation: I can prototype a sampler that emits a `manifest.json` with deterministic golden indices + reservoir meta. will do 2-week spike.
mina: thanks @raul. @sara can you add telemetry wiring for the three metrics above? I can draft the RFC patch for anchor_strategy enums and schema fingerprinting. aim: merge in 2 sprints and roll out as opt-in for Dedicated onboarding first.
sara: yep, I'll add the metrics and dashboards. will also stub runbook entries for manual triage.
mina: sweet. follow-ups: write RFC patch, make sampler PoC, add telemetry and a canary in onboarding for a non-critical model. ping here when PRs ready. :thumbsup:
